Streaming chat completion routed through the proxy

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import ChatCompletionRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    req = ChatCompletionRequest.from_json("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Count to 3\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"openai/gpt-4o\",\"stream\":true}")
    result = client.chat_stream(req)
    chunks = []
    async for chunk in result:
        chunks.append(chunk)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
